prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 医院门诊医生排班表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "心血管内科" spans 1 col × 3 row; "内分泌科" spans 1 col × 2 row; "骨科" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "科室" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "医生" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "职称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "出诊时间" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 138px
  col 5: header "擅长领域" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1042px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助患者按科室查找医生，比较职称、出诊时间和擅长领域，以选择合适的门诊。","reading":"读者先定位合并显示的科室，再横向查看同一行的医生、职称、时间和专长；同科室内也需要纵向比较医生。手机宽度下必须在时间和专长之间分配换行空间。","groups":["科室、医生和职称共同识别就诊对象及其资历，医生姓名是各行的主要定位点。","出诊时间和擅长领域共同支持就诊决策：前者便于比较可用时段，后者用于判断是否适合病情。"],"keep_intact":["尽量保持医生姓名完整，避免跨行拆开。","尽量保持主任医师、副主任医师等职称完整，便于比较。","尽量保持每个星期与上午、下午或全天组成的出诊时段完整。"],"may_wrap":["擅长领域是较长的描述性文字，可自然换行，但会主导行高。","多个出诊时段可在标点处换行。","科室名称可换行；合并单元格覆盖多行，可利用这些行的总高度。","较长的列标题可以换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [53, 67, 68, 98, 73] · table 360×3569px · row heights [60, 571, 478, 501, 478, 501, 478, 501] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 24 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [53, 67, 53, 98, 88] · table 360×2709px · row heights [36, 432, 385, 362, 385, 362, 362, 385] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 18 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [53, 53, 53, 98, 102] · table 360×2174px · row heights [36, 339, 315, 292, 292, 292, 292, 315] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"医生姓名保持完整，出诊时段清楚，科室合并单元格也能明确标示医生所属的组。","problems":"擅长领域每行只有少量文字，描述呈狭长的竖条，行高很大，同一行的其他单元格留下大片空白；擅长领域标题也换行。职称仍有换行。","cause":"擅长领域宽73px，仅有52px的文字空间；职称宽68px，仍不足以完整容纳较长职称。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"医生姓名完整，标题均在一行，出诊时间便于逐行比较；擅长领域比r2A宽，行高明显降低。","problems":"专长描述仍偏窄，行内空白较多；职称尤其是副主任医师被拆成多行，影响资历比较。","cause":"擅长领域宽88px，仅有67px的文字空间；职称宽53px，仅有32px的文字空间。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"擅长领域获得更多空间，段落更容易阅读，行高和空白进一步减少；出诊时间和表头仍清楚。","problems":"多数三字医生姓名被拆开，削弱了各行的定位点；职称也被拆成两三行。科室名称较窄，但合并单元格仍能维持分组。","cause":"医生和职称均宽53px，各只有32px的文字空间；增加专长宽度的代价落在了姓名列。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"姓名与专长平衡","widths":[53,67,53,83,103],"change":"以r2C为基础恢复完整姓名，将出诊时间从98px收至83px，余下空间用于专长。时间列约有62px文字空间，目标是保留四字时段并在时段之间换行，同时让专长保持相对宽松。"},{"name":"兼顾职称","widths":[53,67,68,83,88],"change":"在完整姓名和较紧凑的时间列基础上，将职称加宽至68px，以改善常见职称的换行；专长回到r2B的宽度。用于比较职称可读性与专长行高的取舍，较长职称仍可能换行。"},{"name":"专长优先","widths":[53,67,53,68,118],"change":"保持姓名完整，把更多宽度给长篇专长描述；时间列缩至68px，可能拆开星期与上午、下午等时段。用于检验减少专长行高是否值得牺牲时间的完整性。"}]}
